name: Ice Cave Advancements
summary: Eighteen goals for the frozen caves of the winter update, from the first icicle to defeating a Frostbite while you freeze.
logoPrompt: A glowing blue ice crystal cluster growing out of a block of packed ice bricks inside a dark frozen cave, hanging icicles above, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Eighteen goals for the new ice caves.

description: **Ice Cave Advancements adds a new advancement tab, Frozen Depths, with 18 goals for the ice caves of Minecraft 26.4.**
- Exploring: find the ice caves, collect icicles, ice crystals and brittle ice, and find the music disc hidden in igloos.
- Fighting the cold: defeat a Frostbite, pick up its ice balls, suffer the Freezing effect and brew a Potion of Freezing.
- Building: craft packed ice bricks, chiseled packed ice, snow bricks, polished calcite, calcite bricks and the calcite pillar.
- Three harder goals: defeat a Frostbite while you are freezing, collect every new ice, snow and calcite block, and become an ice cave veteran. These give experience, none give items.
Put the zip into the `datapacks` folder of your world (or pick it when you create a new world). The new tab opens as soon as you enter the ice caves.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 26.4. It only adds advancements, so it is safe to add to an existing world.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers; players need nothing installed.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
